props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially-open value(s) when uncontrolled (no v-model).

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allow multiple sections open at once (default single-open).

props.name: value
props.description: Unique key for this section (used by v-model).

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional leading icon (registered name).

props.name: name
props.description: Optional readable prefix for the auto-generated (already unique) ARIA ids.

props.name: rel
props.description: `rel` for the rendered link. Replaces the default rather than adding to it, matching NuxtLink: with `target="_blank"` and no `rel`, KunUI emits `noopener noreferrer`; passing `rel="noopener"` emits exactly that, which is how you keep the `Referer` header (analytics on the other side count the visit as a referral instead of direct traffic). `noopener` is still added back to any `_blank` link unless the value contains the spec's `opener` token; `rel=""` removes the attribute entirely.

props.name: padding
props.description: Inner padding. Default `lg` (24px).

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Autoplay interval in ms (0 = off). Pauses on hover/focus, off under reduced-motion.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between slides (any CSS length).

props.name: loop
props.description: Seamless infinite loop via slide repositioning (CSS `order`), no cloned DOM. Autoplay glides past the last slide into the first instead of snapping back. Default `true`; auto-disabled when there are too few slides to loop cleanly.

props.name: slidesPerView
props.description: Slides visible at once (>1 for thumbnail strips).

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the dialog.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Shown when `query` is empty (a hint / "recent").

props.name: highlight
props.description: Highlight the query terms in the default item render. Default `true`.

props.name: items
props.description: Results to show: a flat item list (one unlabelled group) OR grouped. You compute these from `v-model:query` — the shell does no matching itself.

props.name: loading
props.description: Async search in flight → a loading state instead of the no-result text.

props.name: noResultText
props.description: Shown when `query` is non-empty but there are no results.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Global open shortcut. `true` (default) = ⌘K / Ctrl-K; a single-char string sets a custom key (still with meta/ctrl); `false` disables it.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name for a drawer with no visible title. Ignored when `title` is set. With neither, KunUI warns in dev.

props.name: isCloseRequestDismissable
props.description: Whether a platform close request dismisses the drawer — in practice Android's back button and back gesture, which close the drawer instead of leaving the page. Desktop is unaffected: its only close request is Escape, handled separately. Ignored when `isDismissable` is `false`.

props.name: isSwipeDismissable
props.description: Whether dragging the drawer downwards dismisses it, and whether the drag handle that advertises the gesture is drawn. Only applies to a drawer sitting on the bottom edge — including a `responsive` one that becomes a bottom sheet below `md` — on a touch-primary pointer, and only while the content is scrolled to the top. Ignored when `isDismissable` is `false`.

props.name: title
props.description: Rendered in the header and wired to `aria-labelledby`. Prefer it over `ariaLabel`.

props.name: placeholder
props.type: string | number | boolean | [w: number, h: number, q?: number, b?: number]

props.name: thumbhash
props.description: A ThumbHash (base64) → a blurred "blur-up" placeholder shown until the image loads, then cross-faded out. Decoded to a tiny image on the client; falls back to the pulse skeleton until decoded (or if the hash is invalid). Implies the wrapper even with `skeleton: false`.

props.name: rel
props.description: `rel` for the rendered link. Replaces the default rather than adding to it, matching NuxtLink: with `target="_blank"` and no `rel`, KunUI emits `noopener noreferrer`; passing `rel="noopener"` emits exactly that, which is how you keep the `Referer` header (analytics on the other side count the visit as a referral instead of direct traffic). `noopener` is still added back to any `_blank` link unless the value contains the spec's `opener` token; `rel=""` removes the attribute entirely.

props.name: src
props.description: Image shown while loading. Defaults to a bundled mascot (base64 data URI — no network request, no consumer asset needed). Pass any URL or data URI to override.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name for a dialog that draws its own heading inside the slot instead of passing `title`. Ignored when `title` is set (that wins, via `aria-labelledby`). With neither, KunUI warns in dev.

props.name: description
props.description: Rendered under the title and wired to `aria-describedby` — the supporting line a `role="alertdialog"` is required to point at.

props.name: isCloseRequestDismissable
props.description: Whether a platform close request dismisses the dialog — in practice Android's back button and back gesture, which close the dialog instead of leaving the page (the behaviour a native `<dialog>` already has). Desktop is unaffected: its only close request is Escape, handled separately. Turn this off for a dialog that is bound to a route and should let back navigate. Ignored when `isDismissable` is `false`.

props.name: isDismissable
props.description: Whether a backdrop click or Escape closes the dialog. `role="alertdialog"` stops the BACKDROP from dismissing (a click that lands on the dim area is not an answer) while Escape still cancels, matching Radix and Reka. Pass `true` to opt the backdrop back in, `false` to turn both off.

props.name: isSwipeDismissable
props.description: Whether dragging the phone sheet downwards dismisses it, and whether the drag handle that advertises the gesture is drawn. Only applies where the sheet exists — `placement="auto"` below `md`, on a touch-primary pointer — and only while the content is scrolled to the top, so a swipe over scrollable content still scrolls it. Follows `isDismissable`, so a `role="alertdialog"` cannot be swiped away any more than it can be clicked away.

props.name: title
props.description: Rendered as the panel's `<h2>` and wired to `aria-labelledby`, so the name a screen reader announces is the one on screen. Prefer it over `ariaLabel`.

props.name: isShowSticker
props.description: Show the empty-state image. Default true.

props.name: src
props.description: The empty-state image. Defaults to a bundled mascot (base64 data URI — no network/CDN request). Pass any URL or data URI to override.

props.name: autoPosition
props.description: Avoid viewport collisions: flip to the opposite side, shift along the edge, and cap height/width to the available space so tall content scrolls instead of overflowing. Default `true`. Set `false` to honour `position` verbatim.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: `trigger="hover"`: ms grace after leaving (crosses the gap). Default 120.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Make the trigger anchor span its container instead of shrinking to its content. Both wrapper divs switch from `inline-block` to `block w-full`, so a full-width trigger (e.g. a `fullWidth` KunButton or a split button) can actually fill the width. Default `false` (inline, content-width).

props.name: group
props.description: `trigger="hover"`: shared id so a row of menus switches instantly between siblings and only one is open at a time (menu-bar behaviour).

props.name: opaque
props.description: Force a fully OPAQUE panel, ignoring a globally-lowered `--kun-surface-opacity` (which sites with a background image use to frost surfaces). Menus/popovers over a busy background usually want this for legibility. Default `false` (follows the global surface opacity). Note: setting `--kun-surface-opacity:1` on the panel yourself does NOT work — Tailwind resolves the themed colour at `:root`.

props.name: openDelay
props.description: `trigger="hover"`: ms before a hover opens. Default 100.

props.name: trigger
props.description: How the popover opens. `'click'` (default) toggles + moves focus into the panel. `'hover'` opens on mouse hover with a coordinate safe-triangle so you can reach the panel without it closing — for navigation menus. Hover never steals focus; click/keyboard/Esc still work, and touch falls back to click.

props.name: color
props.description: Active (liked) colour — a palette key OR any CSS colour string (e.g. a brand `#ff6a00`). The icon fill, pop and burst all follow it. Default `danger`.

props.name: disableAnimation
props.description: Disable the pop / burst / count-roll animations (also off under reduced-motion).

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon name (default a heart); filled + coloured when active. Override the whole glyph (emoji / image / per-state) with the `#icon` slot instead.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label base; the count is appended for the full name. Default `点赞`.

props.name: toggle
props.description: `true` (default) = a like/press TOGGLE: pressed state (`aria-pressed`), icon fill + colour, and a celebratory burst. `false` = a one-shot ACTION (share / more …) in the same compact skin — no self-toggle, no burst, just a tactile pop; handle the click with a native `@click`. Lets a whole reactions row use one component instead of mixing in a heavier icon button. In BOTH modes the filled/coloured skin follows the `active` model. So an action-mode reaction can be a controlled "menu button": wrap it as a `KunPopover` trigger, bind `:model-value` to your own state (e.g. 收藏 = "in ≥1 list"), and the click opens the picker instead of self-toggling.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Click-and-drag with a mouse/pen to scroll the area, like grabbing a strip. A drag past a small threshold suppresses the click so cards inside still work on a normal click; touch is left to native scrolling. Default false.

props.name: scrollbar
props.description: Scrollbar style. `hide` (default) hides it — the edge shadows are the affordance; `thin` shows a slim, theme-coloured scrollbar (a dependency-free alternative to an overlay-scrollbar library); `auto` shows the platform default.

props.name: wheel
props.description: When `axis='horizontal'`, let a vertical mouse wheel scroll the content sideways (mouse users otherwise can't reach off-screen content; trackpads and touch already can). `true` releases at either edge so the page scrolls on past (no scroll-trap); `'contain'` keeps the wheel on the strip at the edges so the page doesn't move — but only while the strip is actually scrollable, so it can never freeze the page. Default false.

props.name: autoRestore
props.description: Auto re-form this many ms after the break completes (0 = stay shattered). Default 0.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the wrapper.

props.name: disableAnimation
props.description: Skip the shard animation and hide instantly. Also forced under `prefers-reduced-motion`. Default false.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable shattering entirely — the content stays put. Default false.

props.name: duration
props.description: Fly-apart duration in ms. Default 1100.

props.name: easing
props.description: Animation-level CSS easing. Default `linear` — the natural ballistic motion is baked into each shard's sampled keyframes, so override this only to time-warp the whole flight.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fade shards out as they fly (false = keep full opacity, e.g. flying off-screen). Default true.

props.name: gravity
props.description: Downward gravity pull on the shards (0 = a pure radial burst). Default 1.

props.name: keepSpace
props.description: Keep the original's layout space after it shatters (`visibility:hidden`) instead of collapsing it (`display:none`). Default false.

props.name: origin
props.description: Where the break originates — shards fly outward from here. `center` (default), `top`, `pointer` (last pointer position over the content), or `{ x, y }` px.

props.name: pieces
props.description: Target number of glass shards (Voronoi cells); clamped to 2–160. Default 24. Fewer is cheaper to build, but the fly-apart stays compositor-only regardless.

props.name: reassemble
props.description: Animate the re-form when restoring — a reverse "reassemble" where the same shards fly back in from where they scattered and settle into place. `false` snaps the content back instantly. Default true.

props.name: rotation
props.description: Maximum random spin per shard, in degrees. Default 140.

props.name: seed
props.description: Deterministic shard pattern: the same seed reproduces the same break (handy for visual tests). Omit for a fresh random shatter each time.

props.name: spread
props.description: How far the shards travel, as a multiplier. Default 1.

props.name: trigger
props.description: How the break is triggered. `manual` (default) = drive it via `v-model:shattered` or the exposed `shatter()` method; `click` = clicking the content shatters it, and the click point becomes the impact origin.

props.name: zIndex
props.description: z-index of the body-level shard overlay. Default 9999.

props.name: animation
props.description: Pulse animation (auto-disabled under prefers-reduced-motion); `none` to turn off.

props.name: height
props.description: CSS height. Defaults: text 1em, rect 1.25rem, circle 2.5rem.

props.name: loaded
props.description: When true, render the default slot (real content) instead of the placeholder.

props.name: variant
props.description: Shape preset: `rect` block, `text` line, or `circle` (avatar).

props.name: width
props.description: CSS width. Defaults: rect/text 100%, circle = height.

props.name: current
props.description: 0-based index of the current step; earlier steps render as done.

props.name: align
props.description: Horizontal alignment of each tab's content (icon + label) inside its box. Mainly visible on vertical / full-width tabs, where the box is wider than its content.

props.name: color
props.description: Dot / medallion colour.

props.name: icon
props.description: Registered icon name → renders a medallion instead of a plain dot.
